title: Cosy Corner Cafe
creator: Sunshine
description: Run your own rainbow cafe! Hand pretzels, pizza, milkshakes, bacon, ice cream, banana bread and fruit platters to customers before they walk past, wrapped, in a box or made allergy safe. Some people ask for two things. With its own pop music!
controls: Tap how to make it, then tap the food. On a computer: Q, W, E, then the number keys.
